lines: Ashwini Amit Dixit, a Promoter Group Selling Shareholder, is offering up to 67,500 shares and could realise up to ₹9.13 crore if all are sold, though the employee-portion discount means actual proceeds may be slightly lower.
The timing is strong: the sale happens at listing, with trading expected to start March 11, 2026, so a call before then is timely.
Post-sale holdings are an estimated ₹64.08 crore at offer price, and the average cost of acquisition is unknown, so the gain cannot be assessed.
Family link: Ashwini Amit Dixit shares the surname Dixit with Amit Arun Dixit, and her middle name Amit is the first name of Amit Arun Dixit, so the two may be related.
